factory.call: build_accepted_custody_ports(selection_store=SelectionStore(dynamodb, IRPT_REQUESTS_TABLE), current_authority=<request-bound (principal, owner)->(scope, directory)>, get_object=s3_object_reader(s3), admitted_firms=<installer's ledgered list; default COT only>) -> CustodyPorts; AcceptedCustodyReader(CustodyBindingStore(...), publication_for=<port 2>, **ports.reader_kwargs())

reads.resource: table irpt-requests, key tenant=<firm> request_revision=SELECTION#sel_<64 hex> (ConsistentRead, via SelectionStore.load, once per call)
<client-firm bucket>/investor-reporting/directory/* (via the installer's current_authority -> _authz.loaders.load_directory; already granted by generate_directory_read)
arn:aws:s3:::opal-data-assets/blackdiamond/cottonwood/silver/fact_holdings/date=*/data.parquet (COT rows, read by VersionId, sha256 + byte_length checked against the receipt)
arn:aws:s3:::opal-data-assets/schwab/*/silver/dim_position/date=*/data.parquet (49financial rows; only when the installer admits 49financial)
the CMK that encrypts the opal-data-assets and opal-data-inf buckets (ARN not resolved by this cell; the release-6 pair names it, CTO 100712 object list)

reads_not_made_here: Port 2 (publication_for capture/load_pinned) is M's and reads the firm publication objects; the binding store (CustodyBindingStore) reads/writes irpt-requests CUSTODY_BINDING# rows (GetItem, PutItem) and is the installer's. The generate role already holds GetItem/PutItem on irpt-requests.
release6_staged_note: custody_interpreter imports custody (CustodyOwnershipRefused), ids (the irpt-common layer python/ids.py) and, lazily, custody_portfolio; custody_portfolio imports intake parse and portfolio. Y's symbol closure on the built zip decides what is already staged.
runtime_prerequisites: pyarrow: the interpreter's default row decoder (intake/custody_interpreter.py _read_parquet_rows) imports pyarrow.parquet lazily. The irpt-ycharts-generate function attaches only the irpt-common layer (generate.tf layers = [irpt_common]), which carries jsonschema, referencing, attrs, rpds, bd_helpers and ids and names no pyarrow. Without pyarrow every custody read refuses CUSTODY_SOURCE_SHAPE (fail closed). Release 6 must stage pyarrow or the installer must pass read_rows.

current_authority: the installer supplies the request-bound (principal, owner) -> (scope, directory) resolver; the recipe is custody.CustodyAccess._current_selection_owner (custody.py:63-88). It must resolve fresh on every call.
